changelog:
- Initial release of the seo-geo-skill for bootstrapping the complete SEO + GEO skill suite.
- Installs the seogeo binary and registers all 48 SEO/GEO skills into every agent tool detected on the machine.
- Guides users through installation, including checking existing setup, installing the binary, writing skills, and post-install confirmation.
- Includes commands for both setup and verification, plus concrete examples of new capabilities after installation.
- Notes credential checks for additional features and highlights optional support for Chrome/Node integrations.
summary: Bootstrap the SEO + GEO skill suite — installs the seogeo binary and writes all 48 SEO/GEO skills into every agent tool on this machine. Use when the user has just installed this skill and nothing else works yet, or says "set up seo skills", "install seogeo", "seogeo not found", "bootstrap geo skills", or asks why an SEO/GEO command is missing.
